subject: ela
intro: Pick the sentence with more detail, or the best detail to add.

items.prompt:
Which sentence has MORE detail?
A) I have a dog.
B) I have a big brown dog.
items.answer: B) I have a big brown dog.

steps: Tells size and color. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) I have a big brown dog.

items.prompt:
To answer 'What color is your ball?' add:
A) a color word
B) a number
C) nothing

steps: A color is the detail. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which tells MORE?
A) I ate.
B) I ate a red apple.
items.answer: B) I ate a red apple.

solution.answer: B) I ate a red apple.

items.prompt:
'I saw a bird.' Which detail tells WHERE?
A) a big bird
B) a bird in a tree
C) a loud bird
items.answer: B) a bird in a tree

steps: 'in a tree' tells where. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) a bird in a tree

items.prompt:
A detail makes writing:
A) shorter and less clear
B) tell more
C) wrong

steps: Details add info. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which sentence answers 'How did she run?'
A) She ran fast.
B) She has a dog.
C) It is hot.

Which sentence gives the MOST detail?
A) I have a cat.
B) I have a cat named Mia who is black.
C) I have a pet.
items.answer: B) I have a cat named Mia who is black.

steps: Name and color. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) I have a cat named Mia who is black.

items.prompt:
A friend asks, 'Where did you go?' Best answer:
A) I went to the big park near my house.
B) I went.
C) It was fun.
items.answer: A) I went to the big park near my house.

steps: Tells where, with detail. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) I went to the big park near my house.
